portal_hypertension.title: Noninvasive Tests for Predicting Decompensation in Compensated Advanced Chronic Liver Disease: A Comprehensive Review.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Payancé A, Rautou PE, Boursier J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：需要强有力的非侵入性测试（NIT）来预测代偿性晚期慢性肝病（cACLD）患者的失代偿并改善个性化患者护理。 临床提示：我们对评估 NIT 在预测 cACLD 患者失代偿或肝脏相关死亡方面的有效性的研究进行了全面回顾。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Strong non-invasive tests (NITs) are needed to predict decompensation in patients with compensated advanced chronic liver disease (cACLD) and improve personalized patient care. We conducted a comprehensive review of the studies evaluating the effectiveness of NITs in predicting decompensation or liver-related death in patients with cACLD. A literature search was conducted in the PubMed database up to August 2025. Prospective or retrospective studies that included patients with cACLD and evaluated NITs for predicting decompensation or death or liver transplantation were included. portal_hypertension.title: Echocardiography, Bile Acids and Spleen Stiffness to Rule Out High-Risk Varices in Children With Biliary Atresia.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Lambert V, Teglas JP, Ackermann O
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：检测胆道闭锁儿童中高出血风险 (HRV) 的胃食管静脉曲张需要从小进行内窥镜检查，以对出血进行一级预防。 临床提示：对变量进行主成分分析，然后进行 HRV 预测的多元逻辑回归分析。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Detecting gastroesophageal varices with a high risk of bleeding (HRV) in children with biliary atresia requires endoscopies from an early age to apply primary prophylaxis of bleeding. However, repeated endoscopies are invasive and costly. This study was performed to define tools to rule out HRV, with the objective of reducing the number of endoscopies. Children with biliary atresia and portal hypertension were prospectively enrolled. Laboratory tests, elastography, echocardiography, and endoscopy were performed. Variables were subjected to principal component analysis, followed by multivariate logistic regression analyses for HRV prediction. The effectiveness of composite models and criteria...

portal_hypertension.title: Development and characterization of dietary models of MASLD with portal hypertension and liver fibrosis in rats.
portal_hypertension.authors: Martínez-Gómez M, Barberá A, Raurell I
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：几十年来，研究人员一直致力于开发一种综合性啮齿动物模型，该模型能够全面概括代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病 (MASLD) 的病理生理学并模拟人类疾病。 临床提示：饮食模型通常被认为是再现人类疾病最可靠的模型；然而，尚未报道与人类MASLD高度相似的饮食啮齿动物模型，限制了病理生理学的研究
portal_hypertension.abstract: For decades, investigators have pursued the development of a comprehensive rodent model that fully recapitulates the pathophysiology of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and mimics human disease. Dietary models are generally considered the most reliable for recapitulating human disease; however, no dietary rodent model has yet been reported with high similarity to human MASLD, limiting the study of pathophysiology and treatment strategies for advanced fibrosis and portal hypertension. Here we conducted a multistep, sequential refinement of our MASLD model in rats until we achieved a comprehensive model that reproduced the clinical features of metabolic syndrome...
